# FRAMEWORK-IMPROVEMENTS — suggestions for cap-evolve itself (cross-run)

NOT about this capability or this run's result — about what cap-evolve the FRAMEWORK should change so FUTURE runs (any capability, any project) go better: a confusing prompt section, a missing tool, a file you wished existed, a gate that felt wrong. Optional most iterations; add an entry whenever something about the framework itself (not the task) got in your way or surprised you.

<!-- cap-evolve:framework-improvements-append-below -->

## cand_0002
- The per-task "action-trace detail" hint in INSTRUCTIONS is truncated mid-token (e.g. "update_reservation_fli", "calculate: agent used"), which is misleading — it looks like an argument value. The genuinely useful signal is `rollout.metadata.tau2_reward_info.action_checks` (the GOLD write actions + `action_match`). Surfacing those gold actions directly in the failing-task summary would save every optimizer from writing a JSON-extraction script.
- Some failing tasks are UN-WINNABLE by any prompt/tool edit because of user-simulator behavior, not agent behavior: task 40's user emits "yes###STOP###" atomically, ending the rollout before the agent's post-confirmation write turn (a passing task gets a separate "yes"). A DB-graded task that requires a write after confirmation is unsatisfiable when the sim never yields the write turn. The harness could flag such "confirmation-then-terminate" traces so optimizers don't burn effort on them (this run's INSTRUCTIONS already hints 40 is infra noise, but only in prose).
- A first-class read-only "DB sandbox" (the run already ships venv + FlightDB.load) would help: an optimizer that can execute the real tool body on the exact failing/passing args is dramatically less likely to ship a regressing guard. Documenting the load path in the guidance would make this the default workflow.
